items.stem: How does SDM send its email notifications?

options.text: By writing directly to each user's mailbox file
It doesn't send email at all

items.explanation: SDM uses the shared Cssd.IT.EmailNotifications library (MailKit) for events like on-hold / temp-job merges.

misconceptions.b: It relays via SMTP, not by writing mailbox files.
misconceptions.c: The syncs move data; email is SDM's own notification path.
misconceptions.d: It does send notifications for certain staffing events.

items.stem: On a developer's machine, an action that should email doesn't actually send. Why is that expected?

options.text: DisableEmailNotifications is true in dev — the message is logged, not sent
Email is permanently removed from SDM
The developer's machine has no network

items.explanation: Dev sets DisableEmailNotifications: true, so emails are written to the audit log rather than delivered. Prod/staging relay through the corporate SMTP.

misconceptions.b: Email works in deployed environments; it's just disabled in dev.
misconceptions.c: It's a config flag, not a connectivity issue.

items.stem: Which staffing categories does SDM manage that drive these notifications (the HR-gap staffing)? Select all that apply.

options.text: Temporary jobs lasting under six weeks
Permanent full-time teachers managed by HR

items.explanation: SDM covers staffing HR doesn't manage — temp jobs under six weeks, contractors, and vendors. Permanent staff remain HR's system of record.

misconceptions.d: Permanent HR-managed staff are HR's responsibility, not the HR-gap that SDM fills.

items.stem: A teammate says "email is broken — I created a temp job locally and no notification arrived." How do you respond?
rubric: Notes that in dev DisableEmailNotifications is true, so nothing is actually sent
Points out the message is written to the audit log instead — check there to confirm it would have fired
Optionally notes prod/staging relay via corporate SMTP (under the service account), so delivery works there
items.sampleAnswer: That's expected on dev — DisableEmailNotifications is set to true, so the notification is logged to the audit log rather than actually sent. Check the log to confirm it would have fired. In staging/prod the servers relay through the corporate SMTP under the app's service account, so delivery works there.
